entities.title: High-score API
entities.summary: POST game, POST score and GET scores under /games/retro/shatterbelt/api/.
guarantees: POST score takes { id, recording: { mode, players, steps, log }, names } with one name or null per player, and answers { results: [{ player, score, wave, name, rank }] } for every player
GET scores answers { scores: [{ name, score, wave, mode, players }] }, at most 10, best first
Errors are JSON { error } with 400, 404, 409, 413, 422 or 500; the sign-in library's own 401 and 403 have { code, message }

entities.title: shatterbelt-scores tables
entities.summary: games (issued seeds) and scores (one row per named player of a replayed game) in D1.
guarantees: A score's id is the seed's id and the player's index, as id:player, and its game column names the seed
A score stores the name, score, wave, mode and number of players; nothing else about the player
Scores are listed best first, ties oldest first (index scores_by_score)
entities.compatibility: schema.sql describes a fresh database; the live one changes only through worker/migrations/ (none yet), applied by hand before merging.

entities.title: Public addresses
entities.summary: The game at /games/retro/shatterbelt/, its scores at /games/retro/shatterbelt/scores/, and the old /retro-games/shatterbelt address.
consumers: Players' bookmarks and links from icelander.net, and the multiplayer page, which opens the game with ?match=ID&mode=coop or versus
guarantees: /games/retro/shatterbelt/scores redirects to the page with a trailing slash
Every path under /retro-games/shatterbelt redirects with 308 to the same path under /games/retro/shatterbelt
